scope: Independent read-only package-script review, followed by main-session generated-GRUB and policy inspection
dkms_autoinstall_all_kernels: commented; automatic coverage of fallback124 is not established

static_review.finding: Old postrm runs on upgrade and targets stale48 from /var/tmp/amdgpu-dkms-kernels before new postinst can refresh the file
static_review.consequence: May generate an unintended initrd or interrupt dpkg, depending on remaining48 files/hooks; neither an observed failure nor harmless skipping is established
static_review.gate: Back up and deliberately reconcile maintenance targets before transaction

static_review.finding: Both postinst scripts write blacklist-amdgpu.conf before invoking DKMS under set -e
static_review.consequence: A failed helper can exit before blacklist cleanup; package simulation does not exercise this
static_review.gate: Record pre-existing blacklist state, inspect actual DKMS results and residual blacklist before reboot

static_review.finding: New prerm removes new DKMS version from all kernels on upgrade, including downgrade rollback
static_review.consequence: Rollback rebuilds old modules and can also fail; --no-remove protects package removals only
static_review.gate: Independent known-good recovery backup and explicit restoration coverage for138 and124

static_review.finding: Generated GRUB contains138 and124 normal/recovery entries, but hidden menu/default0 and disabled persistent initrd backup do not guarantee recovery
static_review.consequence: An old kernel filename is not an independent preserved old-driver environment
static_review.gate: Back up matching initrd/modules/firmware and establish local or out-of-band console access

mixed_stack_limit: APT leaves old graphics and ROCm6.2 package versions unchanged, but replaces shared kernel driver and firmware. Functional preservation remains untested.
